description: This instrumentation enables database connection pool metrics for Vibur DBCP data sources. When no pool name is explicitly configured, the JDBC URL and connection properties are used to derive the pool name. With legacy database semantic conventions, the derived format is `server.address[:server.port][/db.namespace]`. With stable database semantic conventions, the first available value among `db.namespace`, the configured endpoint (`server.address[:server.port]`), and `db.system.name` is used. If none is available, `vibur-dbcp` is used.
